idea_summary: A real-time collaborative whiteboard platform featuring private rooms, Conflict-free Replicated Data Type (CRDT) live drawing synchronization, seamless reconnect state recovery, point-in-time version history snapshots, and multi-format vector/raster export.

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall enforce role-based room membership authorization for creating, viewing, editing, and managing private whiteboard rooms.
acceptance_criteria: Users without valid room membership invitations or tokens receive a 403 Forbidden status code on REST/WebSocket connection attempts.
Room owners can assign 'viewer', 'editor', or 'admin' roles to invitees with immediate propagation.

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall synchronize live drawing operations concurrently across all room participants using CRDT state mutation streams.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent stroke creations and modifications converge without state divergence across all connected peers within 100 milliseconds.
Operation sequence IDs and vector clocks are maintained to resolve conflicting node ordering.

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall support client reconnect recovery via delta-synchronization streams based on the client's last acknowledged sequence ID.
acceptance_criteria: Reconnecting clients send their last sequence ID and receive compressed missing operation deltas without full-board reloads.
Clients offline longer than the ephemeral buffer threshold receive the latest compacted snapshot plus delta log.

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall persist chronological whiteboard history logs and capture incremental point-in-time snapshots for historical traversal.
acceptance_criteria: Every stroke mutation is persisted to append-only storage with a timestamp and user ID.
Users can query and render any historical point-in-time whiteboard state.

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall export whiteboard contents into vector (SVG) and raster (PNG, PDF) formats.
acceptance_criteria: Export engine generates valid SVG, PNG, and PDF outputs preserving all vector stroke data and color properties.
Export jobs complete and return downloadable binary artifacts within standard operational SLAs.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Real-time stroke broadcast latency shall remain minimal under nominal peak traffic.
non_functional_requirements.target: p99 stroke delivery latency < 50ms for rooms up to 50 active editors
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Distributed WebSocket load testing simulating 50 concurrent editors per room emitting 30 events/second.

non_functional_requirements.statement: API Gateway and WebSocket edge infrastructure must enforce strict per-user and per-IP rate limits.
non_functional_requirements.target: Max 120 HTTP req/min per user; max 60 WS frames/sec per connection
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Automated security test suites executing high-frequency bursting against REST and WebSocket endpoints.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Whiteboard mutation history retention and availability must adhere to high durability standards.
non_functional_requirements.target: 99.999999999% (11 9s) object durability with 30-day delta log retention
non_functional_requirements.verification_method: Multi-region replicated blob and database storage audit alongside automated integrity verification tests.

architecture_components.name: API Gateway & Edge Auth
responsibilities: TLS termination and JWT OAuth2 validation
Token-bucket rate-limiting per client IP and authenticated user ID
Route proxying to downstream microservices and WebSocket gateway cluster

architecture_components.name: Room & Access Control Service
responsibilities: Manage room metadata, lifecycle, and access control policies
Generate and validate room session tokens and participant role assignments

architecture_components.name: Real-Time Collaboration Engine
responsibilities: Maintain active WebSocket connection state and publish-subscribe channels
Execute CRDT merge logic and sequence delta broadcasting
Handle reconnect synchronization handshakes and ephemeral delta buffering

architecture_components.name: History & Snapshot Service
responsibilities: Persist append-only mutation events to relational/cold storage
Generate periodic compacted snapshots for quick catch-up and point-in-time time travel
Enforce history retention and pruning policies

architecture_components.name: Export Processing Worker
responsibilities: Reconstruct canvas vector trees at requested revision or snapshot
Render canvas to SVG, PNG, and PDF binary formats asynchronously

data_entities.name: UserAccount
data_entities.purpose: Stores user identity, authentication credentials, profile data, and global permissions.

data_entities.name: WhiteboardRoom
data_entities.purpose: Represents a collaborative whiteboard instance, privacy settings, and active configuration.

data_entities.name: RoomMembership
data_entities.purpose: Maps users to rooms with assigned role permissions (admin, editor, viewer) and invitation tokens.

data_entities.name: BoardMutationDelta
data_entities.purpose: Chronological immutable log of CRDT stroke/shape mutation events with sequence vectors.

data_entities.name: BoardSnapshot
data_entities.purpose: Periodic compacted full-state vector snapshots of the whiteboard for fast recovery and time travel.

data_entities.name: ExportArtifact
data_entities.purpose: Metadata and pre-signed storage URLs for generated vector and raster export files.

api_operations.purpose: Create a new private whiteboard room and assign creator as owner.
Add or invite a user to a private whiteboard room with designated role.
Fetch snapshot and delta events for reconnect recovery starting from a given sequence ID.
Query historical snapshot states and mutation timeline between specified timestamps.
Initiate an export job to render the whiteboard into SVG, PNG, or PDF format.

tests.description: Attempt to access private room REST endpoints and WebSocket channels without valid token or membership, asserting 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden.
Simulate two concurrent clients mutating overlapping whiteboard elements; verify CRDT convergence to identical state on both clients.
Simulate abrupt client disconnect during active drawing stream, re-establish connection with last acked sequence ID, and assert exact delta catch-up.
Verify history log ingestion and point-in-time canvas reconstruction against historical sequence markers.
Trigger whiteboard export across SVG, PNG, and PDF formats and validate generated binary image checksum and vector element integrity.
Load test API Gateway and WebSocket cluster to ensure p99 broadcast latency stays under 50ms with 50 concurrent editors per room.

obligation_coverage.design_response: Implemented RBAC checks at Gateway and Room Access Control service verifying JWT and RoomMembership record before granting access to HTTP endpoints or WebSocket rooms.
Utilized state-based and operation-based CRDT structures with vector clocks handled by the Real-Time Collaboration Engine to achieve deterministic conflict-free convergence.
Engineered sequence-ID-based delta synchronization protocol allowing disconnected clients to request missed operation logs or fallback to latest snapshot + delta.
Persisted immutable mutation streams to append-only durable storage paired with periodic background snapshot compaction and point-in-time query APIs.
Executed dedicated negative security integration test suite asserting 401/403 responses when non-members or unauthenticated actors attempt access.

assumptions.statement: Ephemeral delta memory buffers in the collaboration engine will retain up to 10,000 recent operations per room before requiring a snapshot hydration for reconnecting clients.
Vector and raster export jobs exceeding 10MB or 50,000 canvas elements are processed asynchronously via message queue workers rather than synchronously in the API Gateway.
